en: Points of Controversy The Great Fifty The Twentieth Chapter
Discussion on the Path:
Is it the five-factored path? Yes.
But has not the Eightfold Path been taught by the Blessed One, namely:
right view ... [and so on] ... up to right concentration?
Yes, it has.
If the Blessed One has spoken of the Eightfold Path—namely, right view ...
[and so on] ... up to right concentration—then indeed, it should not be said that "the path is fivefold."
"The five-factored path"?
Yes. But was it not said by the Blessed One:
“Of paths, the Eightfold is supreme;
Of truths, the Four Footings;
Of states, dispassion is supreme.”
"And the Visionary among bipeds.
Is this indeed a sutta?
Yes, it is.
"In that case, the Eightfold Path [is the path].
Is right speech a factor of the path, yet not itself the path?
"Yes."
Right view is a factor of the path; but is it not itself the path?
One should not say so …pe… right speech is a factor of the path; but is it not itself the path?
“Yes, [it is].
Right intention … right effort …” [and so forth].
Right mindfulness ...
[and so on] ... right concentration is a factor of the path, yet it is not the path?
One should certainly not say that ... [and so on].
Is right action …pe… right livelihood a factor of the path, yet it is not the path? Yes.
Right view … [and so on] … right concentration is a factor of the path, yet it is not the path?
One should not say so … [and so on] … Right view is a factor of the path, and it is also the path?
“Yes.
“Right speech is a path-factor, and it is also the Path?
“One should not say so…” [and so on].
Right view is a factor of the path; and is it the path?
Yes. Right action … [and so on] … pe … [as before].
Right livelihood is a factor of the path; is it also the path itself?
One should not say so …pe….
Right intention …pe….
Is right effort …pe… right mindfulness …pe… right concentration a factor of the path, and is it also the path?
"Yes. Right speech ... [and so on] ...
right action ... [and so on].
Is right livelihood a factor of the path, and is it also the path itself?
One should not say so... [and so on] ...
Is it the Noble Eightfold Path?
“Yes.
“But was it not said by the Blessed One:
‘But first of all, his bodily action, verbal action, and livelihood have been thoroughly purified’?”
“Thus this Noble Eightfold Path reaches the fulfillment of its development.
Is this indeed a sutta?
Yes, it is.
"In that case, there is the five-factored path.
"Is there a five-factored path?
"Yes."
"Has it not been said by the Blessed One:
'In whatever Dhamma and Discipline, Subhadda, the Noble Eightfold Path is not found, there no ascetic is found;
there no second ascetic is found; there no third ascetic is found...'"
A true ascetic is not found there; even a fourth kind of ascetic is not found there.
But in whatever Dhamma and Vinaya, Subhadda, the Noble Eightfold Path is found, there a true ascetic is found, and a second... [and] a third... [and] a fourth kind of ascetic is found.
In this very Dhamma and Vinaya, Subhadda, the Noble Eightfold Path is found. Right here, Subhadda—
“Here is a recluse; here is a second recluse; here is a third recluse; here is a fourth recluse. The teachings of others are empty of other recluses.
Is this indeed a sutta?
“Yes,” he replied.
“In that case, it is the Eightfold Path.
The Discussion on the Path is concluded.
